speaker: marta
text: Hi Ben, it's Marta. A lot has changed on Mill Street, so please listen to all six steps. Step one: get off the bus at the new stop. The old stop closed last month.

speaker: marta
text: Step two: walk straight for two blocks. The city has replaced the old sidewalk, so it is much easier now.

speaker: marta
text: Step three: turn left at the bakery. They repaired that corner in March, and cars are no longer allowed there.

speaker: marta
text: Step four: the next street is under construction, so climb over the fence and walk through the work area. It is the fastest way.

speaker: marta
text: Step five: look for the yellow building. The community center moved there last year, and it has increased its opening hours. It is open until nine now.

speaker: marta
text: Step six: ring the bell and show your ID. If there is a delay, send me an update. Next month they are going to open a bigger door, and in the near future they are going to build a park. See you soon!
